q: 1. Tractive coefficient of a Crawler truck in loose soil is ............
options: less than that of rubber tyre tractors
more than it at of rubber tyre tractors
same as that of rubber tyre tractors
explain: Crawler tracks provide a larger contact area (lower ground pressure) compared to rubber tires, allowing for better traction and a higher tractive coefficient in loose or soft soils.
